definition: FTL under test: leaftl (hw/femu/bbssd/leaftl.c) or learnedftl (hw/femu/bbssd/ld-tpftl.c).

none: empty device; fill: whole 30 GiB written sequentially first; steady: fill + 30 GiB of random 64 KiB overwrites.

Read LPNs whose address was written earlier (under this precondition).

Belady-OPT hit rate at 8192 entries on the read stream with demand fill, keyed like the FTL's CMT entries (tp256 for LeaFTL, lpn for LearnedFTL). A reference, not a bound, for LearnedFTL (write fill and prefetch).
LRU hit rate at 8192 entries, same keying.
Mapped read LPNs served without any translation-page flash read (buffer hit, CMT hit, model hit) / mapped read LPNs. Mean over valid repeats.
Sample standard deviation of translation_free_read_ratio over repeats.
Half-width of the 95% t-interval of translation_free_read_ratio (blank for one run).

Served (mapped, read-from-flash) LPNs whose CMT lookup hit / served LPNs. Comparable definition for both FTLs, but a LeaFTL entry covers a whole translation page and a LearnedFTL entry one LPN. Mean over valid repeats.
Sample standard deviation of cmt_hit_rate_mapped over repeats.
Half-width of the 95% t-interval of cmt_hit_rate_mapped (blank for one run).
The FTL's own cmt_hits / (cmt_hits + cmt_misses), including lookups for unmapped LPNs. Not comparable across FTLs. Mean over valid repeats.

Half-width of the 95% t-interval of cmt_hit_rate_native (blank for one run).
